result.question: Which company among the three carries the largest total assets, and how do their balance sheet sizes compare?
result.answer:
Among the three companies, Apple (AAPL) carries the largest total assets. Based on the most recent 10-K filings, Apple reported total assets of approximately $359.2 billion as of September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:Assets:2025-09-27]. NVIDIA (NVDA) reported total assets of approximately $206.8 billion as of January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Assets:2026-01-25]. Tesla (TSLA) reported total assets of approximately $137.8 billion as of December 31, 2025 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Assets:2025-12-31]. Apple's balance sheet is the largest of the three, with NVIDIA's balance sheet exceeding Tesla's, and Tesla carrying the smallest total assets.

NVIDIA has likewise filed subsequent interim balance sheets showing continued growth: total assets of approximately $259.5 billion as of April 26, 2026 [0001045810-26-000051:table-0003] and approximately $320.3 billion as of July 26, 2026 [0001045810-26-000073:table-0003]. Even at NVIDIA's most recent interim figure of approximately $320.3 billion, Apple's total assets of approximately $359.2 billion from its 10-K remain larger, while Tesla's $137.8 billion remains the smallest of the three.
